summary: BrightSpring Health Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated June 3, 2026 for a secondary offering of 14,999,771 shares of common stock at $58.75 per share by selling stockholders, including KKR Phoenix Aggregator L.P. and management stockholders. The company did not receive proceeds except from stock option exercises, and repurchased 1,026,465 shares from the underwriter. The offering was made under an existing Form S-3ASR. While the share repurchase is a capital return element, the filing primarily discloses a secondary sale by existing holders, not a transformative special situation. Watch for any further KKR stake reduction or insider selling; no risk-arb angle applicable.
